meta.title: Plugin development toolkit
meta.description: Adds plugin-development help to Creator mode only. Creator mode gains dsh_plugin_new, which generates a complete plugin package from the standard template; dsh_plugin_check, which reports the structural problems that stop a bundle from installing or displaying; and two skills: dsh-plugin-new for the interview that feeds the generator, and dsh-plugin-isolated-test for testing a plugin in a dsh web instance with its own DSH_HOME, profile, and port. Other presets gain nothing. Removing the bundle removes the tools and the skills with it, and the Creator-mode preset falls back to the shipped declaration. Generated bundles patch no preset, so installing one changes no existing preset. The checks are read-only and need an absolute bundle directory; they do not parse the patch file as YAML, so YAML syntax errors are not caught.
